# Abbott Incentives

> Abbott Incentives is a premier tax credit consultation and management company specializing in state incentive programs, tax credit optimization, and business growth solutions for enterprises across the U.S.

Abbott Incentives provides comprehensive end-to-end program administration for state and local tax incentives, serving CPAs, private equity firms, manufacturers, and large enterprises. The company combines deep expertise in tax credit management with strategic capital architecture to maximize ROI and cost reduction for clients.
